reviewScope: Recovery execution machinery only: exact historical continuation, restart durability, recovered evidence provenance, publication replay, and execution authorization. This is not a Gate-H scientific verdict and does not change H-v2 HOLD standing.
claimUnderReview: A reviewed recovery run can continue the failed H-v2 developmental attempt without regenerating completed development, without replaying successful historical provider calls, and without allowing the resulting world to replace the frozen H-v2 HOLD or enter G5/G6 evidence.
notClaimed: The recovery world is a replacement #39 cohort.
The recovery world may enter frozen G5/G6 diagnostics.
Provider execution is authorized by this review artifact.
propertiesThatHold: The frozen recovery binding remains a zero-provider-call boundary.
The exact first unfinished developmental operation is slot 4 episode 3 record retry #2.
Completed slot 1-3 generation artifacts are blob-bound and are not regenerated.
Slot 5 is demonstrated to have zero historical model attempts.
New successful model invocations are durably journaled and replayed by exact request witness on restart.
Publication uses the existing Genesis/#37/#38 authority and verifies Thread integrity after publication.
A separate execution-authorization witness is required; the historical recovery binding is not mutated to authorize calls.

findings.finding: The reconstructed slot-4 generation artifact under-represented historical cognition provenance: preserved episodes 1-2 had empty call lists and episode 3 exposed only continuation calls although six successful source responses existed.
findings.requiredResolution: Carry all six frozen successful historical responses and the historical repair/retry witnesses explicitly into recovery state and the reconstructed generation evidence without treating them as new recovery calls.
findings.currentResolution: Recovery-state reconstruction now mechanically verifies the historical transitions and exposes acceptedEpisodeEvidence, successfulHistoricalCalls, and historicalRepairWitnesses. The orchestrator still needs to consume these fields in the recovered generation artifact.

findings.finding: Recovered-world publication does not currently persist Genesis generation-attempt witnesses for Pass-A repairs/retries or Pass-B repair calls, although the original H runner did.
findings.requiredResolution: Persist generation-attempt witnesses idempotently for preserved and newly generated Threads before birth publication, including the recovered historical repair trail.

findings.finding: Underlying historical-continuation and durable-invocation mechanisms are tested, but the full recovery orchestrator composition has not yet been exercised with a deterministic fake provider through restart/publication behavior.
findings.requiredResolution: Add a no-real-provider execution test or equivalent mechanically load-bearing composition test proving exact first-call behavior, durable replay after restart, slot ordering, and publication idempotence without creating a production authorization bypass.

findings.finding: The future authorization witness must bind the final reviewed orchestrator blob after R1-R3 are closed; binding an earlier implementation would defeat the review boundary.
findings.requiredResolution: Create no execution authorization until all review fixes are committed and locally green, then bind the exact final orchestrator blob, recovery-binding digest, first provider operation, and non-evidentiary standing.

findings.finding: Orchestrator preflight output currently prints authorization as absent and says no provider call was authorized even after a future valid authorization witness exists.
findings.requiredResolution: Make preflight wording reflect authorization presence while continuing to state that preflight itself makes zero provider calls.

authorization.clearCondition: R1-R5 resolved, local active suite and validation green, zero-call preflight green, and final reviewed implementation blob frozen.
